src: filled monochrome square objects s, grouped by side length after ignoring non-square noise and the lowest square when it is smallest
match_cond: a side group s contributes to slot d_k iff count(s) >= k
transform: draw each slot as nested upper-left square masks, larger sides first; append one bg separator column after every slot
grid_shape: height is largest side + 1; width is sum of slot widths plus one separator per slot
